lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct horizontal rows starting posterior to the gill slits, with increasing spatial separation towards the posterior image boundary.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs, creating a discernible grid-like arrangement of nodes on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous horizontal feature on the upper flank characterized by a high-luminance top edge and a low-luminance shadowed lower gradient, extending from the post-cranial region through the upper flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible superficial white linear abrasions or scars located on the dorsal-lateral surface above the primary carinae ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin demonstrates a significantly higher spatial density and smaller diameter of high-luminance blobs compared to the primary lateral flank patterning.
